words.definition: to confuse to a point at which no progress can be made
words.example: The unusual test results continued to baffle the researchers because no theory could explain them.
words.zh: 混亂到無法取得進展的地步

words.definition: to produce, to carry; to show; to endure
words.example: This orchard bears many fine harvests of apples.

words.definition: to make something difficult to see
words.example: The rain blurred everyone's view of the valley.

words.zh: 非常明亮或色彩豐富；聰明的

words.definition: to alert someone of danger, warn someone to take care or pay attention to something
words.example: The officer cautioned the motorist to slow down.
words.zh: 提醒某人有危險，警告某人小心或註意某事

words.definition: to increase the value, power, quality, or beauty of something
words.example: Passing the exam should enhance your chances of being admitted to college.
words.zh: 增加某物的價值、力量、品質或美觀

words.definition: to make easier: to ease the progress of
words.example: His careful planning facilitated the completion of the project.
words.zh: to make easy: 讓進展變得容易

words.example: The woman's incessant talking disturbed everyone watching the movie.
words.zh: 不間斷的、持續的或永無止境的

words.example: Regular exercise, in conjunction with a balanced diet, can improve long-term health.
He was intrigued by the acclaim that he received.

words.definition: to prevent movement, progress, or success
words.example: Just after the storm, downed trees obstructed many roads in the community.

words.definition: to change a belief or behavior by argument or reason
words.example: They couldn't persuade their critics to see their point of view.
words.zh: 透過論證或理由改變信念或行為

words.definition: a repayment or reward for a deed
words.example: The knight received gold as recompense for saving the kingdom.

words.definition: to throw off naturally; to give out
words.example: In order to grow, crabs must shed their shells.

words.definition: to be the only one of a kind; special
words.example: He was presented with a unique opportunity to attend the conference.
words.zh: 成為獨一無二的；特別的

words.definition: to be complementary or appropriate; a good match
words.example: The design of the house is well-suited to its surroundings.
words.zh: 是互補的或適當的；一場很好的比賽

words.definition: to end or cause to end successfully; to develop
words.example: Their ambitious plan will likely work out.
words.zh: 成功結束或導致結束；發展
